brief:
Israeli former Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot called for the arrest of settler terrorists and the removal of National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir and Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich from government, the Maan Wire reported. Eisenkot said the two ministers have driven the West Bank toward collapse.

The statements reflect growing criticism within Israeli security circles over settler violence and the role of far-right government ministers in West Bank policy. Ben-Gvir and Smotrich, both leading figures in the Religious Zionism party, have backed settlement expansion and taken hardline stances toward Palestinians.
title: Eisenkot demands arrest of settler terrorists and removal of Ben-Gvir and Smotrich
